task: observed cell lines, fixed 0.5 uM dose, globally unseen drug structure groups: control cell population + drug structure -> treated cell population (unpaired populations; not the same cells before/after)

cells.expression: log1p(1e4 * count / library_size) per real cell, 2,000-gene panel
cells.sample_rule: blake2b(barcode) threshold, ~64 cells per (well, cell line); built by the prior study

sources.raw_mirror: not read by this study (the 128/256-cell extension was not justified by the stability diagnostic)
sources.deleted_prior_assets: $PRIOR_V2/v2/raw was deleted on 2026-11-16 (manifests/chemcpa_moe_v2/deleted_2026-11-16.json); not needed here

cache.note: same cells re-ordered by (well, cell line) then barcode hash; no cell created, duplicated or perturbed

units.well: (well sample, cell line) group of real cells
units.bootstrap_unit: drug structure group (all its cell lines together)

split.rule: one role per drug structure group across all cell lines (prior study, seed 20261112): 209 train / 70 val / 70 test
split.development: inside TRAIN drugs only: 3 folds by blake2b('r3-devfold|'+group SMILES); fit folds {0,1}, evaluate fold 2; 8 cell lines by metadata coverage (valid train conditions, then sampled cells, then id)
split.validation_drugs: not used by any step of this study
split.test_drugs: scored once after freeze_manifest.json; treated statistics never enter generation, anchoring or restoration

inputs_allowed: same-plate DMSO cells of the same cell line and their statistics (mean, variance, zero fraction)
ECFP4 2048-bit fingerprint of the drug structure group
inputs_forbidden: any treated-cell statistic of a validation/test drug (means, library size, zero fraction)
n_rule: n = min(observed, control, 64) cells per well for observed and generated alike; wells with n < 32 dropped
hcc_target: SNU-423 (CVCL_0366), reported separately. HepG2/C3A (CVCL_1098) is a training/evaluation line and is not called adult HCC
caveats: train and test conditions share plates and DMSO pools
public benchmark already analysed by this project; not a blind cohort
